01-02.title: 眼睛先认出我，笑容却被喷壶拦住

01-03.title: 他的后退让我看清退路

subtitles.en: Fix the sign, then. Stay out of the house.
Understood.
Nora? Do you know this guy?
Yes, he's fixing the greenhouse. Breakfast is waiting. Come in when you're done.
subtitles.zh: 认识，修温室的。早餐给你留着，忙完进来。

subtitles.en: I was hoping for a letter of recommendation.

01-05.title: 只开院门，不开放私人空间

subtitles.en: At least it saved your name before it fell.
subtitles.zh: 至少它落下来之前，还保住了你的名字。

subtitles.en: We still need a No Trespassing sign.
subtitles.zh: 门口还缺一块“禁止擅入”。

subtitles.en: Add: Please don't water the repairman.
subtitles.zh: 顺便加一行，“请勿给修理工浇水”。

subtitles.en: We'll see how you do.

02-01.title: 早餐与没被翻开的本子

02-03.title: 熟悉的口味，没出口的话

02-05.title: 脱外套的误会，给一个自然回望

subtitles.en: You have to undress to fix a window?
Not the window. Trying to be useful requires moving my arms.
subtitles.zh: 修窗不用。想表现得有用一点，需要活动胳膊。

subtitles.en: This part's free. Don't pay extra just because I rolled up my sleeves.
subtitles.zh: 这部分免费。别因为我卷了袖子就加钱。

02-06.title: 一起搬架，第一次行动合拍

subtitles.en: I was about to charge you for talking.
Getting to work.
Can this one be saved?
Yes. It's just drowning.
subtitles.zh: 有。它只是被水泡得喘不过气。

subtitles.en: We have a lot in common.
It's quieter.

02-07.title: 三个性格，三个能养活的承诺

subtitles.en: This one's yours. No water yet.
Entrusting me with a life already?
It's a plant.
I know. My résumé isn't good enough for a dog yet.
subtitles.zh: 我知道。我的履历还没好到能直接领狗。

subtitles.en: Mint. Good for tea.
Finally, a coworker handling refreshments.
subtitles.zh: 终于有同事负责下午茶了。

subtitles.en: Keep it alive first.
Hear that? Promotion standards are brutal.
subtitles.zh: 听见了吗？我们的升职条件很苛刻。

02-08.title: 抽屉比情话更暴露关系

subtitles.en: How did you know where the pen was?

02-09.title: 笑意退去，温室安静下来

subtitles.en: Maisie, did you read the notebook by your breakfast this morning?
subtitles.zh: 麦溪，你今天早上看过桌边那个本子吗？

subtitles.en: What notebook?
I think we should sit down.
subtitles.zh: 我想我们应该先坐一会儿。

subtitles.en: Have we met before?
Yes.
When?
Maisie, you went straight out to the fallen sign this morning. I put your notebook beside breakfast. I thought you'd read it first, like usual. I didn't check.
subtitles.zh: 麦溪，早上你先去看掉下来的招牌了。我把本子放在早餐盘旁边，以为你会像平常一样先看。是我没跟上。

03-03.title: 明天早上，我会忘记今天

subtitles.en: What notes?
You had an accident. You remember your life before it. But new memories don't stay after a night's sleep.
subtitles.zh: 你出过一场事故。你记得以前的生活，但新发生的事，睡过一夜就留不住。

subtitles.en: I remember right now. The sign, the coffee, his terrible joke.
subtitles.zh: 我现在不是记得吗？招牌，咖啡，还有他那个很差的笑话。

subtitles.en: Today, you do.
subtitles.zh: 今天的事，你现在能记得。

subtitles.en: We're talking about tomorrow morning.

03-A1.title: 有笑话，也有不想见他的日子

subtitles.en: Maisie, this is your notebook. Check today's date, then the latest page. Nora's next door if you need her.
subtitles.zh: 麦溪，这是你的本子。先看今天日期，再看最新一页。想找人问，诺拉就在隔壁。

subtitles.en: He put a label on upside down. I laughed and spilled my coffee.
subtitles.zh: 他把标签贴反了。我笑得咖啡都洒了。

subtitles.en: Didn't feel like talking today. He finished the repairs and left. Didn't push.
subtitles.zh: 今天不想聊天。他修完就走，没有追问。

subtitles.en: That handwriting… it's mine.

03-B1.title: 昨天的我没有替今天笑

subtitles.en: Hey.
It's me.
You're probably tired of this opening.
subtitles.zh: 这个开场，你大概已经听烦了。

subtitles.en: Since the accident, we wake up without the new memories.
subtitles.zh: 那场事故以后，每次睡醒，我们都会失去新形成的记忆。

subtitles.en: The notebook tells you where the hospital papers are, and what's happened lately.
subtitles.zh: 本子里记了医院资料放在哪里，还有最近发生的事情。

subtitles.en: Eat something first. You don't have to read everything at once.
subtitles.zh: 先吃点东西。不要一次读完全部。

subtitles.en: Also, that Rowan guy is kind of annoying. Admit it if he makes you laugh. If he doesn't, you owe him nothing.
subtitles.zh: 还有，那个洛温确实有点烦。你笑了再承认，没笑不用给面子。

03-05.title: 每天一次，已经快到三个月

subtitles.en: How many times have you seen me?
Once a day. Almost three months now.
subtitles.zh: 每天来一次。快到三个月了。

subtitles.en: Do I chase you off with a watering can every day?
No. That one's new.
subtitles.zh: 没有。那个是今天的新项目。

subtitles.en: I didn't even know the date. And you were letting me pick flowers.
subtitles.zh: 我连今天是几号都不知道，你们刚才还在让我挑花。

subtitles.en: I'm sorry. I saw you working and assumed you knew. I guessed. I didn't ask.
subtitles.zh: 对不起。我看见你出来做事，就以为你已经知道了。那是我猜的，没问你。

subtitles.en: Go outside for a while.
Okay.
That crossed-out letter. I always fix it like that. This is mine.
subtitles.zh: 那一笔划错又补上的字，我总是这样改。真的是我写的。

04-01.title: 把事实放在明早一定能看见的地方

subtitles.en: Do I have to find this out every day?
subtitles.zh: 我是不是每天都得知道一次这种事？

subtitles.en: Some mornings you read a few lines.
Sometimes you ask a lot.
No two days are the same.

04-03.title: 门两边，谈真正想要的事

subtitles.en: Do you come here hoping for the same result every day?
subtitles.zh: 你每天来，都想得到同一个结果吗？

subtitles.en: At first, I really came to fix things.
subtitles.zh: 来修东西，一开始真是这个。

subtitles.en: And then?
Then I hoped you'd want to talk a little longer.
subtitles.zh: 后来我希望你愿意多跟我说两句。

subtitles.en: Do you already know every line that'll make me laugh?
subtitles.zh: 你是不是已经知道所有能逗笑我的话？

subtitles.en: A few. Some worked once, then didn't.
subtitles.zh: 知道几句。也有原来管用，后来不管用的。

subtitles.en: You memorized the answers?
Yeah. Afraid I'd get it wrong.
Sounds like a test.
Then I failed today. When you were upset, I kept searching for a line to fix it. I should have shut up and listened.
subtitles.zh: 所以今天考砸了。你生气的时候，我还想找一句能把气氛拉回去。我该闭嘴听完。

04-B1.title: 告白与边界同一句讲清

subtitles.en: What exactly were we?
subtitles.zh: 我们之前到底是什么关系？

subtitles.en: I like you. Some days, you wanted coffee with me. Other days, just the repairs. We never agreed we were a couple.
subtitles.zh: 我喜欢你。你有几天愿意和我喝咖啡，有几天只想让我干活。我们没有确定恋爱关系。

subtitles.en: Don't fill that part in for me.
I won't. I want to ask. But the answer is yours.
subtitles.zh: 不会。我想问，但要你自己回答。

04-C1.title: 玩笑之后是一句可靠的答案

subtitles.en: What if I don't like you tomorrow?
subtitles.zh: 如果明天我又不喜欢你呢？

subtitles.en: I'll be sad. Probably go home and swear at that unlucky window latch.
subtitles.zh: 会难过。可能回家骂两句那个倒霉窗闩。

subtitles.en: What did the latch do?
Nothing. It can't argue back.
If you don't want to see me tomorrow, we don't meet.
Liking you shouldn't make you afraid to close your own door.
subtitles.zh: 喜欢你这件事，不该让你连门都不敢关。

subtitles.en: Tomorrow, check that I know first. No guessing.
subtitles.zh: 明天你来的时候，先确认我知道了。别再猜。

subtitles.en: I'll ask.
And no 'you liked this yesterday.' I might not today.
subtitles.zh: 也别跟我说“你昨天喜欢”。我今天可能不喜欢。

subtitles.en: I'll have to stay flexible.
subtitles.zh: 那我得准备得灵活一点。

subtitles.en: That doesn't mean writing a new answer sheet.
subtitles.zh: 不是让你写新的标准答案。

subtitles.en: Got it. Bring a brain. Leave the script.
subtitles.zh: 明白。带上脑子，别带剧本。

subtitles.en: The chair just made a better point than I did.
You could be a little quieter.
Tomorrow, after breakfast.
Tomorrow. After breakfast.
Okay.
Come back alive.
We'll both do our best.
Tomorrow. After breakfast.
Okay. Can I take this?
Come back alive.
We'll both do our best.
Tomorrow. After breakfast.
Okay. Can I take this?
Come back alive.
We'll both do our best.
Later that evening, back at the table, I wrote:
subtitles.zh: 那天晚上，我回到桌前写下：

subtitles.en: Finding out today hurt.
subtitles.zh: 今天知道这些时很难受。

subtitles.en: Rowan didn't get everything right.
subtitles.zh: 洛温并不是什么都做对了，

subtitles.en: But he listened until I was finished.
I asked him to come tomorrow.
Read your few lines today?
After breakfast. That's what we agreed.
Morning. I'm Rowan. This is my probationary coworker.
subtitles.zh: 早。我是洛温。这位是试用期同事。

subtitles.en: It's only been one day.
Early-stage company. Don't focus on scale.
subtitles.zh: 创业初期，别盯着规模看。

05-A1.title: 券放口袋，口味却听你的

05-B1.title: 把鱼转正，笑话也救不回来

subtitles.en: I want the actual sea.
Guaranteed water. Wetter than the drawing.

05-B2.title: 风把精心准备的帅气吹乱

subtitles.en: Nice hair.
Limited edition. No photographs, please.

05-C1.title: 一张空白卡，变成共同的一小时

subtitles.en: Help me organize the greenhouse. These labels need finishing before we open.
subtitles.zh: 陪我整理温室吧。开门营业前，这些标签得弄完。

subtitles.en: A date at your workplace. You negotiate benefits well.
subtitles.zh: 约会地点是工作单位。你谈福利很有一套。

subtitles.en: Don't come, then.
Didn't say that. Does the employee get to pick afternoon tea?
subtitles.zh: 没说不来。员工能选下午茶吗？

subtitles.en: There's one more thing I'd like today.
Didn't you already get a plant?
subtitles.zh: 你不是已经拿走一盆花了？

subtitles.en: A plant won't do for this.
There's one more thing I'd like today.
Didn't you already get a plant?
subtitles.zh: 你不是已经拿走一盆花了？

subtitles.en: A plant won't do for this.
There's one more thing I'd like today.
Didn't you already get a plant?
subtitles.zh: 你不是已经拿走一盆花了？

subtitles.en: A plant won't do for this.
Another interview tomorrow?
Yes. Leave drawing off your résumé.
That leaves honesty.

05-06.title: 记录的是选择，不是标准约会

05-07.title: 另一个早晨，工作可以接着做

05-08.title: 开门营业，比恋爱更像她自己

05-09.title: 我把自己的开门日期挂出去

subtitles.en: When do you open?
Saturday, at ten. I'd love to see you.
Saturday, at ten. I'd love to see you.
Good news. Found the leak.
subtitles.zh: 好消息，我把漏水点找到了。

subtitles.en: Bad news?
It found me.
Easy. There's another shirt under this one.
Who's getting excited?
Me. I'm hoping for a towel.

05-12.title: 毛巾是一句没说出口的靠近

05-H1.title: 忍不住展示一下，又被看穿

subtitles.en: Expanding the inspection?
Checking for slacking.
Reporting in. Worked very hard today.
Here. Next time you want me to look at you, just ask.
subtitles.zh: 拿好。下次想让我看你，可以直接说。

subtitles.en: Then look at me now.
Okay. More effective than planned.
So, were you looking for a towel, or looking at me?
subtitles.zh: 所以，刚才到底是在找毛巾，还是在看我？

subtitles.en: Ask again and I'll bite.
Gently. Still have to move your shelves tomorrow.
subtitles.zh: 轻点。明天还得给你搬花架。

05-K2.title: 轻轻一下，立刻看他的反应

05-K3.title: 他笑着把主动权变成邀请

subtitles.en: Okay, message received. You weren't kidding.
subtitles.zh: 好，收到。原来你不是说着玩的。

subtitles.en: Still asking?
Nope. For now, you were looking for the towel.
subtitles.zh: 不问了。我暂时决定，你是在找毛巾。

subtitles.en: But next time you want to get closer, you can skip the warning.
subtitles.zh: 不过，下次你想靠近，可以跳过警告。

subtitles.en: You really can't stay quiet.
subtitles.zh: 你这个人，真的很难安静。

subtitles.en: Back to work.

05-14.title: 我写下今天真正发生的事

06-01.title: 新一天，从昨天完成的工作出发

06-A0.title: 昨天的反馈，有书面证据

06-02.title: 他为工间休息准备了一支舞

subtitles.en: Thought we could use this on opening day. Let's test it.
subtitles.zh: 开门那天可以用这个，先试试声音。

subtitles.en: Boss. Break time. May I have this dance?
subtitles.zh: 老板，工间休息。给我一支舞？

06-A1.title: 两步就够，笑是现长出来的

subtitles.en: Does your lesson include feet?
subtitles.zh: 你这个教学包不含脚吗？

subtitles.en: Included. No extra charge if you break them.
subtitles.zh: 包含。踩坏了也不另收费。

subtitles.en: A little closer?
Okay.
Two steps and you're this tired?
Yep. Absolutely an exercise issue.
subtitles.zh: 嗯。绝对是运动量的问题。

subtitles.en: Okay. It has very little to do with dancing.
subtitles.zh: 好吧，跟跳舞没什么关系。

subtitles.en: Ticklish here?
A little. You look very happy about discovering that.
subtitles.zh: 有一点。你看起来很高兴发现这个。

subtitles.en: Now I can make you quiet.
subtitles.zh: 以后有办法让你安静了。

subtitles.en: You can just come closer. Much less trouble.
subtitles.zh: 你可以直接靠近，不用那么麻烦。

06-F1.title: 终于承认：这部分是我想抱你

subtitles.en: Forget the steps. Just stay here.
subtitles.zh: 舞步可以忘，站这里就行。

subtitles.en: You're cutting corners on this lesson.
I admit it. This part's mostly me wanting to hold you.
subtitles.zh: 我承认，这部分主要是我想抱你。

06-04.title: 今天的我，也应该被看见

subtitles.en: You looked so happy yesterday. I wanted to see that again.
subtitles.zh: 昨天你笑得很开心。我想再看到。

subtitles.en: Did you see me today? I just said I didn't like it.
subtitles.zh: 那你看见今天的我没有？我刚刚说我不喜欢。

subtitles.en: I see you. I'm sorry.

06-05.title: 他最怕的是明天那一页

subtitles.en: Will you write this part down too?
subtitles.zh: 今天这段，你也会写进去？

subtitles.en: You don't want me to?
I'm afraid tomorrow you'll only read the part where I messed up. And won't want to see me.
subtitles.zh: 我怕你明天只看到我说错话的这段，就不愿意见我了。

subtitles.en: If you only let me keep the best few minutes, the person I meet tomorrow won't be you.
subtitles.zh: 可你让我只留下最好的那几分钟，我明天认识的就不是你了。

subtitles.en: You're right. I was still trying to write myself a good review.
subtitles.zh: 是。我刚才还在想怎么给自己写一份好评。

subtitles.en: Write it. What happens next is yours to decide.
I want something quieter. Got anything?
subtitles.zh: 我现在想听安静一点的。你有吗？

subtitles.en: I'll learn again. No special treatment for yesterday's me.
subtitles.zh: 我重新学。别给昨天的我开后门。

subtitles.en: You've already had two retakes today.
subtitles.zh: 你今天已经补考两次了。

subtitles.en: Yeah. Taking actual notes this time.

06-G2.title: 把不舒服和愿意都写下

subtitles.en: We had a small fight. He picked yesterday's favorite song. I didn't like it. He understood, and we changed it. I want to see him tomorrow.
subtitles.zh: 今天吵了一小架。他拿昨天的喜好替我选歌，我不喜欢。他听懂了，我们换了歌。我愿意明天再见他。

06-H1.title: 答应离开，也是一种靠近

subtitles.en: I need some time alone. Come move the shelves tomorrow.
subtitles.zh: 我想自己待会儿。明天再来搬花架吧。

subtitles.en: Okay. What time?
After breakfast. Ten.

06-H2.title: 今天不留他，也保留明天

subtitles.en: We had a small fight.
He picked yesterday's favorite song.
subtitles.zh: 他选了昨天我最喜欢的歌。

subtitles.en: I didn't like it.
I asked him to leave, and he did.
Tomorrow we'll keep getting ready to open.
subtitles.zh: 明天，我们继续准备开业。

07-01.title: 营业日的第一项工作是核对记录

subtitles.en: You kept it alive.
Can I get a dog now?
Get this one through probation first.
subtitles.zh: 先把这一盆的试用期过完。

subtitles.en: There's a record this time. You win.

07-03.title: 我凭自己的记录完成第一单

subtitles.en: Is this one reserved?
subtitles.zh: 这一盆已经有人预订了吗？

subtitles.en: Let me check. Yes, here's the order. I can show you another.
subtitles.zh: 我查一下。对，这里有订单。我给您看看另一盆。

subtitles.en: Let me check. Yes, here's the order. I can show you another.
subtitles.zh: 我查一下。对，这里有订单。我给您看看另一盆。

subtitles.en: Let me check. Yes, here's the order. I can show you another.
subtitles.zh: 我查一下。对，这里有订单。我给您看看另一盆。

subtitles.en: Let me check. Yes, here's the order. I can show you another.
subtitles.zh: 我查一下。对，这里有订单。我给您看看另一盆。

07-04.title: 隔着花架，也能分享高兴

subtitles.en: The notebook didn't mention opening a shop would be this exhausting.
subtitles.zh: 本子上没有写，开门会这么累。

subtitles.en: Bad news. No returns on the register either.
subtitles.zh: 坏消息，收银台也不能退货。

subtitles.en: Your bonus.
Do I look bonus-worthy now?
subtitles.zh: 现在像不像值得发奖金的人？

subtitles.en: Like you just conned your way into cake.
Any chance I can get a dance too?
subtitles.zh: 还有机会骗到一支舞吗？

07-B1.title: 他发现自己得到了偏爱

subtitles.en: Special treatment?
You did well today.
Then I'd like to request more specific praise.
subtitles.zh: 那我申请把表扬说得更具体一点。

subtitles.en: I like this seat.
Don't put it on tomorrow's schedule.
subtitles.zh: 别急着写进明天的安排。

subtitles.en: Today's. I know.
Why so quiet?
Trying to look like I've done this before.

07-07.title: 他忍住了一个庆祝拥抱

subtitles.en: I'd like you to stay a little longer.
subtitles.zh: 我愿意和你再待一会儿。

subtitles.en: I read about the days you came. And the days I asked you to leave.
subtitles.zh: 我读过你每天来的记录，也读过我让你走的那几天。

subtitles.en: Yeah.
When I sold my first plant today, you looked happier than I did.
subtitles.zh: 今天我卖出第一盆花的时候，你看起来比我还高兴。

subtitles.en: I really wanted to run over and hug you. Then I saw you counting money. Cash flow comes first.
subtitles.zh: 我特别想冲过来抱你。后来发现你正在数钱，应该优先保护现金流。

07-08.title: 把玩笑收好，认真说喜欢

subtitles.en: I'm done counting.
And Rowan. I really do like you today.
subtitles.zh: 还有，洛温。我今天是真的喜欢你。

subtitles.en: I like you too. Wanted to say it all day.
subtitles.zh: 我也喜欢你。想跟你说一整天了。

subtitles.en: Right now, I want to hold you. And kiss you.
subtitles.zh: 那现在，我想抱你。还想吻你。

07-E1.title: 第一次，他等到“来吧”才靠近

subtitles.en: Come here.
Remember that clever line yet?
subtitles.zh: 那句聪明话，想起来了吗？

subtitles.en: No. And you didn't exactly seem to be waiting.

07-12.title: 写给明天的自己，也给他一个明天

subtitles.en: Today, the greenhouse reopened. I checked my own orders. I got them right. Rowan helped put away the last box.
subtitles.zh: 今天，温室重新开门了。我查了自己的订单，没有弄错。洛温陪我收了最后一个箱子。

subtitles.en: Tomorrow, if he still feels unfamiliar, that's okay. Finish your own page first.
subtitles.zh: 明天，如果你还不熟悉他，不用着急。先把自己这一页读完。

subtitles.en: I don't want this to be only him making the effort, every day. I want to give him something to look forward to too.
subtitles.zh: 我希望这不只是他每天努力来见我。我也想给他一点盼头。

08-02.title: 我留下的是生活，不只是他

subtitles.en: We opened yesterday. You were nervous for hours. You made that first sale anyway. Orders are in the back. Check them.
subtitles.zh: 昨天开门营业了。你紧张了半天，第一单还是做成了。订单都在后面，记得核对。

subtitles.en: Rowan's coming tomorrow. I invited him. Don't spend all morning checking whether you like him. Ask what you want to do today too.
subtitles.zh: 洛温说明天来。是我约的。别光忙着检查你喜不喜欢他，今天也看看自己想干什么。

08-A1.title: 昨天的我，比我想得勇敢

subtitles.en: I pulled him back for the second kiss… Did I have to write that much detail?
subtitles.zh: 第二次是我拉他回来的……这句就不能少写一点吗。

subtitles.en: Later, he kissed the back of my hand too.
subtitles.zh: 后来他还吻了我的手背。

subtitles.en: I haven't stayed in the day of the accident. My life kept happening.
subtitles.zh: 我并没有停留在事故那一天。我的生活还在继续。

subtitles.en: I didn't expect you to have a place ready for me, before I even got here.

subtitles.en: After the kiss, I didn't want to let go. Yesterday must have been good.
subtitles.zh: 后来我不想放开。昨天一定过得挺好。

08-A1-hot.title: 昨天的我，比我想得勇敢 / hot

subtitles.en: I said I was warm, and he let go. Apparently he called that cooling down.
subtitles.zh: 我说热，他就松开了。他好像还把这叫“降温”。

08-A1-pause.title: 昨天的我，比我想得勇敢 / pause

subtitles.en: He let me catch my breath. Still thinking about cake. This guy…
subtitles.zh: 他说让我缓一会儿。还惦记蛋糕。这个人……

08-A1-hugonly.title: 昨天的我，比我想得勇敢 / hugonly

subtitles.en: I asked him to hold me first. I need to meet this man.
subtitles.zh: 我先让他抱的。得见见这个人。

08-A1-handonly.title: 昨天的我，比我想得勇敢 / handonly

subtitles.en: He didn't rush me. I want to know what he'll say today.
subtitles.zh: 他没有催我。我想知道他今天会说什么。

08-A2-hair.title: 连他认输，都有记录 / hair

subtitles.en: I messed up his hair, then fixed it for him.
subtitles.zh: 我弄乱他的头发又替他理好了。

08-A2-shoulder.title: 连他认输，都有记录 / shoulder

subtitles.en: We sat together, my head on his shoulder.

08-A2-bite.title: 连他认输，都有记录 / bite

subtitles.en: I asked him to hold me closer. He teased me again. I gently bit his neck, and he laughed and surrendered. I laughed too.
subtitles.zh: 我让他抱近一点，他又逗我。我轻轻咬了他的颈侧一下。他笑着认输，我也笑了。

subtitles.en: I even wrote down his surrender… Yesterday's me was very pleased with herself.
subtitles.zh: 连他认输都要记下来……昨天的我还挺得意。
